build_dispatcher: build a Dispatcher instance to dispatch functions based on matching signatures
build_var_dispatcher: build a VarDispatcher that calls functions with variable pattern matching and substitution
create_match_decorator: create a match decorator to register functions with signature-based dispatch in a namespace
test_supercedes: test the supercedes function to check if one pattern is more specific than another
build_ordering: build an ordering of signatures using topological sort based on specificity edges
